claim_scope: secondary discovery evidence on an already-exposed parent population

predecessor_boundary.result: OBS and BM25 were live, but all matched, shuffled, and resend official tool accuracy was zero because no output formed a valid nonempty name/arguments call
predecessor_boundary.terminal_rule_honored: No predecessor response is reparsed, normalized, rescored under a new parser, or recontacted; no predecessor threshold or retrieval setting changes.
predecessor_boundary.distinct_successor_variable: The successor preserves the already-frozen Audio2Tool direct-answer output envelope and adds a label-free structural USE canary before completing USE on a block-disjoint cohort.

population.name: A2T-CPV2-104
population.parent_exposure: EXPOSED by prior Audio2Tool discovery work
population.block_key: tier plus query number parsed from media_relpath
population.selection_rule: Exclude every parent item whose block key occurs in A2T-G1-104. Within each tier, rank remaining items by SHA-256(namespace + NUL + sample_id), then sample_id, and take the first 13.

M0_DIRECT.input: original speech plus the complete registry
M0_DIRECT.instruction: Use the existing Audio2Tool direct prompt byte-for-byte, including the exact example [{"name": "x", "arguments": {}}].

OBS_SELF_TRANSCRIPT.input: original speech plus the frozen ASR-only English instruction

USE_CANARY.selection: one independently hash-ranked item per tier, each contacted once with matched evidence and once with its fixed same-tier shuffled donor evidence

structural_gate.valid_output: raw response is unfenced exact JSON, a nonempty array of at most four objects, every object has exactly name and arguments, name is a frozen registry member, and arguments is an object
structural_gate.failure_consequence: stop before the remaining 192 USE contacts; do not open gold or scorer

USE_MATCHED.input: original speech, own accepted self-transcript, and BM25 values retrieved from that transcript
USE_MATCHED.output_contract: The original Audio2Tool exact output sentence and example remain the final text in the system instruction.

USE_SHUFFLED_EVIDENCE.input: original speech, own accepted self-transcript, and evidence retrieved from a fixed same-tier donor transcript

MATCHED_RESEND.selection: two independently hash-ranked matched requests per tier
MATCHED_RESEND.request_identity: canonical request payload bytes must equal the sealed matched source payload bytes

features: M0 parse and top-five target-set relation bucket
forbidden_features: tool, facet, value, domain, or category identity
sample, tier, donor, or fold identity
gold, score, reward, matched response, shuffled response, or future turn
training_free_control.support_semantics: A later support flight must freeze this discovery memory and apply it without reading support rewards; it may not cross-fit on support.

wave_1.unit: one complete verified 104-row manifest per process

scoring.efficiency_report: record wall time, summed job time, effective speedup, worker count, manifest count, and per-job result hashes

terminal_rules.failure: Close this contract-preserving cascade on A2T-CPV2-104. Do not change the output envelope, structural canary, BM25, evidence budget, state bins, memory thresholds, or promotion gates on its returns. Do not run support or scale.
terminal_rules.success: Permit only a separately preregistered, query-block-disjoint approximately-104 support proposal using the frozen discovery memory. Support success may propose, but not execute, an approximately-1,000 engineering experiment with a separately decontaminated knowledge build.
